A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' [[Marriage/Legends|married]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], and the two [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a [[Veers family|son]] named [[Zevulon Veers]]. The family embodied the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] ideals given Maximilian's service in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. The woman [[Death/Legends|died]] on a holiday prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[File:Veers-hd.png|thumb|right|300px|The female individual married Maximilian Veers.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]]<ref name="DESB" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] soon after the [[insurrection on Culroon III]]<ref name="Characters" /> between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] his wife and [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] his [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Zevulon Veers]], following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and that Zevulon was a teenager in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, the marriage and Zevulon's birth must have occurred by [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]] at the latest.</ref> The two only [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] one [[Veers family|son]], [[Zevulon Veers]],<ref name="Characters" /> and their family embodied [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] ideals, as Veers was a proud [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] with a loyal and productive family.<ref name="Databank" />

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Death date" /> the family took a vacation, where Veers's wife [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to a rare [[Disease/Legends|disease]].<ref name="DESB" /> The death damaged Maximilian's sense of infallibility,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and in response to the sudden loss, Maximilian buried himself in his work<ref name="Characters" /> and told Zevulon to honor his [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] memory by joining the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Databank" /> Zevulon had an unhappy childhood afterward<ref name="DESB" /> with his strict disciplinarian father<ref name="Databank" /> and missed the warmth of his mother's smile.<ref name="DESB" />

Maximilian continued to rise to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]], and after his success in defeating the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Fact File 45">{{FactFile|45|VEE 3-4|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Characters" /> he was thrust into the public eye by Imperial propaganda as an example of a widower with a loyal son destined to follow in his footsteps.<ref name="Fact File 45" /> Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the battle, Zevulon [[Desertion/Legends|defected]] to the Alliance.<ref name="DESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maximilian Veers's wife was first mentioned in ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', a [[1993]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Michael Allen Horne]].<ref name="DESB" />
